invariants.description: All /admin routes must require authentication and admin role
invariants.example_valid: 401/403 returned for unauthenticated or non-admin access

invariants.description: Every admin action must check the current user role permissions before executing
invariants.example_violation: Operator accessing super-admin-only endpoint without permission check
invariants.example_valid: 403 Forbidden when role lacks required permission

invariants.description: Non-super-admin roles cannot escalate their own or others' role level
invariants.example_violation: Admin with OPERATOR role changing their role to SUPER_ADMIN
invariants.example_valid: 403 Forbidden when non-super-admin attempts role escalation

invariants.description: Delete, batch delete, and irreversible state changes must require explicit confirmation
invariants.example_valid: DELETE requires confirmation_token in body or header

invariants.description: Soft-deleted records must not appear in default list queries unless explicitly requested
invariants.example_violation: GET /api/products returns archived/deleted products without explicit filter
invariants.example_valid: GET /api/products only returns non-deleted; ?includeDeleted=true shows all

invariants.description: Entity status transitions must follow defined state machine rules; invalid transitions rejected
invariants.example_violation: Changing order status from DRAFT directly to SHIPPED without CONFIRMED

invariants.description: Sensitive fields (price, role, permissions, status) require specific permissions to modify
invariants.example_violation: Operator updating product price without price:write permission
invariants.example_valid: 403 when user lacks field-specific write permission

invariants.description: Batch operations must specify scope (filters, IDs, limit) and return affected count
invariants.example_violation: POST /api/batch-delete with no filter — deletes everything

invariants.description: Create, update, delete, status change, role change, and export operations must create audit log entries
invariants.example_violation: Deleting a user without creating audit_log record with operator_id and timestamp
invariants.example_valid: Every sensitive action creates audit_log entry with actor, action, target, timestamp, details

invariants.description: Data export (CSV, Excel, JSON) must require explicit export permission
invariants.example_violation: Any admin can export all user data without export permission

invariants.description: All imported data must pass schema validation, uniqueness checks, and business rules before insertion
invariants.example_violation: CSV import inserts rows with invalid emails or duplicate IDs
invariants.example_valid: Import validates each row; rejects invalid rows with line-level errors

invariants.description: All list endpoints must enforce pagination with a maximum page size limit
invariants.example_violation: GET /api/products returns 50,000 records with no pagination

invariants.description: Search and filter parameters must be validated against a whitelist of allowed fields; raw SQL injection prevented
invariants.example_violation: GET /api/products?search=1;DROP TABLE users;-- executing raw SQL
invariants.example_valid: search parameter validated against allowed columns; parameterized queries used
